limitations: This is not a same-Agent paired adoption experiment.
The baseline engines are allowed to retain intermediate tables in memory; RowTrail pays for disk durability and process isolation.
CLI startup is included for RowTrail; direct DataFusion process wall time is also recorded separately.
No claim of stable performance advantage is justified by these small local trials.
